dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Reception. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: rɪˈsɛpʃən. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi, this is Room 305. Is it possible to get an extra pillow?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ðɪs ɪz ˈruːm ˈθriː oʊ ˈfaɪv. ɪz ɪt ˈpɑːsəbəl tə ˈɡɛt ən ˈɛkstrə ˈpɪloʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll bring one up.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪl ˈbrɪŋ ˈwʌn ˈʌp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Would it be possible to have a late checkout tomorrow?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. wʊd ɪt bi ˈpɑːsəbəl tə ˈhæv ə ˈleɪt ˈtʃɛkaʊt təˈmɑːroʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can check out at two. It's free.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, juː kən ˈtʃɛk ˈaʊt ət ˈtuː. ɪts ˈfriː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! And is there a hair dryer in the room?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ɪz ðɛr ə ˈhɛr ˌdraɪər ɪn ðə ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's in the closet. Do you need anything else?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ɪn ðə ˈklɑːzɪt. duː juː ˈniːd ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is it possible to borrow an iron? And would it be possible to have a wake-up call at seven?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈpɑːsəbəl tə ˈbɑːroʊ ən ˈaɪərn? ənd wʊd ɪt bi ˈpɑːsəbəl tə ˈhæv ə ˈweɪk ʌp ˌkɔːl ət ˈsɛvən?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No problem. I'll bring the iron with your pillow.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. aɪl ˈbrɪŋ ði ˈaɪərn wɪð jʊr ˈpɪloʊ.
